preconditions.name: ofc_trained_head_bias_cross_candidate_range_supra_floor
preconditions.description: ARM_1 trained-head OFC bias cross-candidate RANGE (max-min over the real candidate bank) at the high-threat positive-control state clears BIAS_RANGE_FLOOR -- the selection-distribution DVs (devaluation shift, task-role separation) can be non-zero only if the bias carries cross-candidate range. RANGE not magnitude (a clamp-saturated head has large |bias| but ~0 range). 485f raises ofc_bias_scale 0.1->0.5 to defeat the 485e clamp-saturation that starved this on 2/3 seeds.
preconditions.control: trained-arm bias over a real candidate bank at the high-threat state

preconditions.name: ofc_head_weight_delta_supra_floor
preconditions.description: ARM_1 state_bias_head weight-delta-from-init L2 norm clears HEAD_DELTA_MIN -- the head genuinely trained (485d C2 statistic).
preconditions.control: trainable-arm head trained on frozen-encoder state_code in P1
